draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks again for making time for the welcome call last week. Following up on what we discussed: the usual first step is getting one project started, since projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project together on a short call this week -- just reply with a time that suits you.

Best,
Nadia
